description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class for managing bank account and transaction operations using Spring Web annotations. It provides endpoints for retrieving account details, adding new accounts, transferring funds, and fetching transaction histories.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: REST controller handling account and transaction-related HTTP requests. Uses Spring annotations to map endpoints for CRUD operations and transfers, delegating business logic to the BankingServiceImpl.

methods.name: getAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of all account information objects in JSON format.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Fetches account details for a specific account number, returning an HTTP response entity.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account associated with a customer number using provided account information.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs fund transfer based on the provided transfer details for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves transaction history for a specified account number.
